:::{#def-notational-shorthand}
#### Notational shorthand

A **notational shorthand** is a way of writing an [expression](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/expressions-algorithms.html#def-expression)
that leaves part of the expression out,
such as the set a sum runs over or the limits of an integral,
and relies on the reader to supply the missing part from context.

:::
